title: Postdoctoral Project Researcher in AI-enhanced Theoretical Physics
institution: Kavli Institute for the Physics and Mathematics of the Universe (Kavli IPMU)
about: Kavli IPMU seeks a postdoctoral project researcher for the JST PRESTO project "Human-AI Collaboration for Theoretical Physics", combining physics research with building and evaluating agentic AI systems. Submission deadline December 1, 2026; later applications may still be reviewed.
requirements: PhD in physics or a related field by the start date
Desired start April 1, 2027 (negotiable); contract can continue until March 31, 2030, possible extension to September 30, 2030
Supported by the JST PRESTO project "Human-AI Collaboration for Theoretical Physics" (PI Leander Thiele)

upskill.name: Agentic AI & Multi-Agent Systems II
why: Role: "combining physics research with building and evaluating agentic AI systems" -> Objective: "Tool-augmented agents: code execution, web search, API calls"
Project: "Human-AI Collaboration for Theoretical Physics" -> Objective: "Human-in-the-loop oversight and agentic safety"
